source: Hand-curated from MLIT 羽田空港のこれから (new-route per-municipality maps), ward/city pages, MLIT Haneda noise-monitoring network, 防衛省 北/南関東防衛局 住宅防音 pages — see per-flag url
method: Track B, manual refresh (see data/DATA_LOG.md item 6b). Municipality-level flags only — not a noise contour. 'con' = a published low-altitude route over populated parts of the municipality (official altitude ≈1 km or lower); 'info' = higher routes, military airfields or designated noise zones that cover only part of the municipality. Areas without an entry had no aircraft-noise finding in these sources (it does not prove silence: road/rail noise is not covered). Altitudes are quoted only where an official page states them.

kinds.hanedaS: Haneda new route, south-wind arrivals (A/C runways): 15:00–19:00, ~3 h/day on south-wind days (~40% of the year), up to 44 arrivals/h (Shinjuku-ku page). Aircraft descend toward Haneda, so wards nearer the airport on the path are overflown lower than Shinjuku.
kinds.hanedaSHigh: Haneda new route, south-wind arrivals — municipality on MLIT's list of per-municipality route maps but upstream of central Tokyo, i.e. higher than over Shinjuku (≈1 km).
kinds.hanedaN: Haneda new route, north-wind departures from C runway northbound along the 荒川: 7:00–11:30 and 15:00–19:00 (≈3 h of each window).
kinds.hanedaB: Haneda south-wind departures from B runway (over the Kawasaki waterfront).
kinds.hanedaChiba: Haneda conventional routes over Chiba (arrivals/departures; MLIT raised approach altitudes over Chiba City 5,000→7,000 ft). An MLIT Haneda noise-monitoring station is located in this municipality.
kinds.shimofusa: JMSDF Shimofusa air base (training flights); mayors of Kashiwa, Funabashi, Kamagaya and Shiroi filed a joint request on aircraft noise (2023-10).
kinds.atsugi: NAF Atsugi: MOD 第一種区域 (residential sound-proofing zone) reaches Machida only at 金森5・6丁目 (MOD notice 2025-12). Carrier air wing jets moved to Iwakuni in 2018.
kinds.kisarazu: JGSDF Camp Kisarazu (helicopters; also the US/JGSDF V-22 maintenance depot). The JGSDF Osprey interim deployment was scheduled to finish moving to Saga by mid-Aug 2025 (MOD 2025-04-15).
kinds.tachikawa: JGSDF Tachikawa airfield (helicopters) is inside the city; USAF Yokota is ≈5 km west. Whether any part of Tachikawa is in Yokota's 第一種区域 was not confirmed from public sources.
